data.one_liner: Web implementation of firebase_core for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides the platform-specific code to initialize and use Firebase on Flutter web. It registers the web implementation of the core Firebase plugin and keeps the Firebase JS SDK up‑to‑date.
use_when: Building a Flutter app that runs on the web and needs Firebase initialization
You want the official Firebase support for web without writing platform code
avoid_when: Targeting only mobile or desktop platforms
You need Firebase services beyond core (e.g., Auth, Firestore) without adding their web plugins
strengths: Official FlutterFire plugin with timely updates
Handles web‑specific setup like script loading and dart2wasm flags
weaknesses: Only works on web; no effect on other platforms
Requires firebase_core as a companion package
data.setup_notes: Add firebase_core and firebase_core_web to pubspec, run flutter pub get, and configure Firebase via the web config snippet in index.html as described in the FlutterFire docs.

alternatives.name: firebase_core
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a cross‑platform Firebase core plugin that includes the web implementation internally
